{{Quote|Call it a meteorite storm....|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Meteorite storms'''<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> or '''meteorite showers'''<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref> were celestial events in which [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorites]] descended through a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and struck the ground, resulting in a dangerous hail of burning space rocks.<ref name="Unknown">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] proclaimed that the destruction of [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] resulted from a critical failure of the [[shift shield]]s during a meteorite storm.<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>
